question: With what assurance is the speaker prepared to state the manner in which death is destroyed?
premises: The speaker states an intention to tell.
The matter to be told is the manner in which death is destroyed.
inference: The speaker tells, without doubt, how death is destroyed.
uncertainties: The method by which death is destroyed is not given in this verse alone.
plain_english: I tell it; there is no doubt, that death is destroyed as such.
